name: 李曉祺
objective:
本課程涵蓋以下主題：
1. 數字的進制轉換以及二進制表示方式
2. 布林代數式與函數
3. 數位電路化簡技巧，如卡諾圖與製表法
4. 組合邏輯電路，如：加法器/減法器、比較器、多工器、邊/解碼器
5. 可編程邏輯電路，如：唯讀記憶體/可編程唯讀記憶體（ROM / PROM）、可編程邏輯電路（PLD）、可編程邏輯陣列（PLA）
6. 順序邏輯電路，如：狀態機

Introduce the principles of digital logic. Topics includes:
1. Number representation, number bases and base conversions, and binary codes
2. Boolean algebra and functions
3. Combinational design techniques: K-maps, tabulation method
4. Combinational logic circuits: adders/subtractors, comparators, multiplexors/demultiplexers, and decoders/encoders
5. Programmable logic circuits: read-only memory/programmable read-only memory (ROM/PROM), programmable logic devices (PLD), and programmable logic arrays (PLA)
6. Sequential logic circuits: state machine
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1: Introduction & Numbering Systems
Week 2-3: Boolean Algebra & Logic Gates
Week 4: Minterm & Maxterm expansions
Week 5-6: Karnaugh Maps
Week 7-8: Quine-McClusky Method, Multi-Level Gate Circuits (1)
Week 9: Midterm Exam
Week 10: Multi-Level Gate Circuits (2)
Week 11-12: Latches and Flip-Flops
Week 13: Registers and Counters (1)
Week 14-15: Registers and Counters(2), State Machine 
Week 16: Final Exam
